items.title: Nike Falls 3% to a Fresh 52-Week Low as China Weakness Overshadows Its Wholesale Rebound
items.summary: Nike just hit a fresh 52-week low even as its wholesale numbers are actually improving, and the contradiction at the heart of that gap reveals why Wall Street analysts are split further apart on this stock than almost any other name in retail.
